lines: d34: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Kurt Quintana is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d34: 🕯️ Kurt is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d34: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d34: 🕯️ Kurt Quintana is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d34: What Kurt kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d34: "Kurt's gone." Bao looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Kurt." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d34: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Esperanza blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d34: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
d34: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d34: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d34: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d34: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Kurt Quintana, 34 days. The mantle passes to Esperanza Ndiaye.
d34: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Esperanza Ndiaye, 33 — a postal worker. Their hands know different work now: Night Eyes, Lucky Rock, Bird Whisperer, Trophy Room.
d34: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Stalker of the Apex Predator." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d34: The village's quarrel was with Kurt — and Kurt is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d34: At the grave, Bao, Purificacion, Nino and 1 more speak for Esperanza — "Kurt trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d34: The fire knew Esperanza before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
